$comment: The single source of truth for what version this is. scripts/set-release.mjs writes it into the web build, the Android Gradle config and the Xcode project, so the three can never disagree -- a mismatch between the version a user reports and the build you have is a support conversation that goes nowhere.
$build_note: Both stores require this to increase with EVERY upload, including one that was rejected. Bump it before each submission.
